📍 Ozioma

Field Ministry Companion

Offline-first, privacy-focused app for Jehovah's Witnesses. Built for Port Harcourt, Lagos & Calabar field conditions.

📄 Export as PDF Install Guide

1. About & Objectives

Ozioma (Igbo: good news) solves paper territory cards + notebook loss + poor signal. Local device is primary DB, cloud is sync target only.

Objectives: Reduce admin 80%, protect householder privacy, work 100% offline, enable congregation coordination with START/STOP pins + voice guidance.

2. Who It's For

Publishers

Track house-to-house, see where to start/stop on live map, log RVs with one tap.

Pioneers

Goal progress bars, Bible study lesson tracker, KML export.

Elders / Service Overseers

Assign territories, split oversized ones, approve new publishers, view % complete.

4. Scope & Specs

In Scope

  • Territory cards, GPS pinning, NH/RV/DNC statuses
  • RV profiles + timeline + Bible study logs
  • Timer + monthly report
  • Offline Mapbox PH/Lagos/Calabar (z10-16, 80-145MB each)
  • Walk-to-map creator + Snap to Roads + Split + KML
  • Congregation sync + Live Field Map + Voice + Multi-brother

Out of Scope

Not replacing jw.org / JW Library. No chat, no social feed.

7. Database & Installation

Supabase Schema (excerpt)

CREATE TABLE territories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  congregation_id UUID REFERENCES congregations(id),
  number TEXT, name TEXT,
  boundary_geojson TEXT,
  start_lat DOUBLE, start_lng DOUBLE,
  stop_lat DOUBLE, stop_lng DOUBLE,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'available',
  assigned_to UUID REFERENCES profiles(id)
);
-- RLS: WHERE congregation_id = (SELECT congregation_id FROM profiles WHERE id=auth.uid())

Install

flutter pub get
dart run build_runner build
# set MAPBOX_TOKEN in .env
flutter run
# Tiles: Open Territories > Offline Maps > Download PH/Lagos/Calabar on WiFi

8. Privacy & Security

Privacy: Local-first. SQLCipher encrypted. Biometric gate. Sharing opt-in only, auto-off 12pm, deleted after 60min. Householder names never leave device unless you sync.

Security: RLS congregation isolation, HTTPS TLS 1.3, AES-256 key in Keychain/Keystore, No PII in crash logs, DNC list local-only option.

9. How to Use — For Brothers

  1. Join with code RUMUOLA-PH-2024
  2. Elder assigns #14 → push notification
  3. Field Map → Navigate (voice: "340m to START")
  4. Tap People icon → see Bro Emeka 50m away if sharing
  5. Door-to-door: swipe Unvisited→NH/RV/DNC, log RV question
  6. Begin Work button starts timer
  7. Back on WiFi → auto syncs to congregation

Not an official app of jw.org. Built for Rumuola Congregation, Port Harcourt.
